description: This Kotlin file defines the MainActivity class for an Android TV application. It extends FragmentActivity, manages a TextView for displaying the app name, and handles remote control key events such as select, back, and enter.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the Android TV application, handling UI setup and remote key events.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and updates the title text from resources.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote control key events for navigation and selection.
